notes:
Summary: Mid-market multi-tenant chat/agent platform focused on embedding assistant features into customer-facing products. Primary ask: validate Hosted API for streaming-first UX (tool-calls + function invocation) then consider Dedicated for predictable cost and tenancy isolation.

Key constraints and priorities:
- Latency SLO: customer wants p50 first-token < 200ms for US region, p99 < 600ms acceptable with fallback; streaming stability critical for tool-calls (webhook/agent actions).
- Multi-tenant quotas: per-tenant rate limits & quota metering required (per-customer billing attribution). Need token-level usage logs and per-tenant throttles + burst support.
- Security: SSO (SAML) + audit logs + optional EU residency for enterprise customers. KMS integration asked for in Dedicated conversation.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to commit to reserved capacity if pricing tiers map to tenant billing bands.

Quotes from call:
- CTO: "We want streaming to feel instantaneous; if the first token takes >300ms users notice. We need a clear fallback to lower-tier models if capacity spikes."
- Head of Platform: "Per-tenant quotaing is the dealmaker — billing accuracy and throttles without a lot of engineering work."

What we've done so far:
- Demo of Hosted API streaming + function calling (1/14).
- Shared perf baseline report from Redwood hosted tests (2/02).
- Delivered initial pricing sketch for Dedicated reserved pools (2/20).
- Security questionnaire submitted; legal review queued (Drive link).

Open items for Redwood sales/SEs:
- Provide a perf harness scripts + sample concurrency load profile (we promised a runnable k6 script and sample dataset).
- Clarify quotas: how tenant tags map to billing metrics and whether throttles can be soft/hard.
- Confirm SAML flow and send example assertion metadata contract.
- Provide committed ARR pricing for 3 sizing tiers (small / medium / large multi-tenant pools).
